class.name: ResonanceBakeConfig
class.brief_description: Per-volume bake settings for Steam Audio probes.
class.description: GDScript resource assigned to [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_config]. Auto-created on the volume when empty in the editor. Save as .tres for reusable presets. When null at bake time, [method create_default] is used. Controls reflection algorithm, pathing bake, static source/listener passes, and bake quality. [member reflection_type] should match [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reflection_type] for playback (BakeConfig has no TrueAudio Next). Pathing visibility fields ([member bake_pathing_vis_range], [member bake_pathing_radius], [member bake_pathing_threshold], etc.) are also read at runtime from the first loaded probe volume with a bake config.

method.name: get_bake_params
method.description: Returns the bake parameter dictionary passed to the native baker (rays, bounces, pathing ranges, reflection type). Used internally by the bake pipeline.

method.name: create_default
method.description: Creates a new config with project defaults. Used when [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_config] is null.

members.member: Reverb algorithm for the reflection bake: Convolution (0), Parametric (1), Hybrid (2, default). Should match [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reflection_type] at runtime.
Bakes pathing connectivity between probes. Required when runtime pathing is enabled. When false, pathing sub-properties are read-only in the inspector.
Maximum distance in meters (10-2000) for mutual probe visibility during pathing bake and runtime pathing. Higher values cost more CPU.
Maximum path length in meters (10-500) between probes for pathing bake.
Visibility samples per probe (4-128) for pathing bake. Higher values are smoother but slower; runtime may use [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.pathing_num_vis_samples] separately.
Probe sphere radius in meters (0.1-2.0) for pathing visibility tests. Used at bake and runtime.
Fraction of unoccluded rays required to link probes (0.01-1.0). Lower values admit more paths and increase bake time. Used at bake and runtime.
Bakes Static Source layers from [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_sources] on the owning volume (one pass per valid NodePath).
Bakes Static Listener layers from [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_listeners] on the owning volume (one pass per valid NodePath).
Ambisonics order (1-3) for baked convolution IRs. Higher order improves spatial detail and increases bake size and time.
Reflection rays per probe (256-16384). More rays improve quality and lengthen the bake.
Reflection bounces per ray (1-32). More bounces lengthen the reverb tail and the bake.
Parallel bake worker threads (1-64). Affects bake duration only; not included in probe outdated hashes.
